children: traded higher on Wednesday after announcing that one of the top 20 biopharma companies has chosen Vault CRM, its customer relationship management platform.

According to the Pleasanton, California-based health tech, 14 of the top 20 biopharma companies have selected Vault CRM, including the latest addition, expanding its reach to more than 190 live customers.

Being a part of the Veeva Vault CRM Suite, Vault CRM brings together sales, marketing, and medical teams of a healthcare organization on a single platform, leading to more efficient consumer engagement
Veeva (VEEVA) has recently disclosed that Big Pharma companies, including Amgen
, have committed to Vault CRM globally.

"Together, we're establishing a fundamentally new way of working that helps bring medicines to patients faster and more efficiently with the next generation of CRM,” said Arno Sosna, president of CRM Suite at Veeva

title: Veeva Systems gains new top 20 biopharma win for Vault CRM
